## Setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(readxl)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(plotly)
library(purrr)
source(file.path(getwd(), "pipeline", "config.R"))
```

## Import data sources

```{r import_data}
# Scryfall set-name -> set-code lookup
sets_lookup <- read_csv(
  scryfall_set_lookup,
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# Scryfall card lookup table built from bulk data
scryfall_cards <- read_csv(
  scryfall_cards_lookup,
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    set_code = tolower(set_code),
    collector_number = as.character(collector_number)
  )

# Card Kingdom buylist sheet
today <- Sys.Date()

today_file <- file.path(
  buylist_master_dir,
  paste0("cardkingdom_buylist_master_", today, ".csv")
)

if (!file.exists(today_file)) {
  message("No CK file for today found. Running merge...")
  source(file.path(tcg_root, "pipeline", "merge_buylist.R"))
} else {
  message("Today's CK file already exists. Skipping merge.")
}

ck_files <- list.files(
  buylist_master_dir,
  pattern = "^cardkingdom_buylist_master_\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}\\.(csv|xlsx)$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

latest_ck_file <- ck_files[which.max(file.info(ck_files)$mtime)]

if (grepl("\\.csv$", latest_ck_file, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
  ck_buylist <- read_csv(latest_ck_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
} else if (grepl("\\.xlsx$", latest_ck_file, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
  ck_buylist <- read_xlsx(latest_ck_file, sheet = 1)
}
ck_buylist <- ck_buylist %>%
  select(
    name,
    set,
    collector_number,
    finish,
    cash_price,
    credit_price,
    max_qty
  )
```

```{r Batch Inventory}
if (file.exists(tcg_path("master", "inventory.csv"))) {
  inventory <- read_csv(
    tcg_path("master", "inventory.csv"),
    show_col_types = FALSE,
    col_types = cols(
      `Collector number` = col_character(),
      `Scan Order` = col_character(),
      Quantity = col_double(),
      `Scryfall ID` = col_character(),
      `Set code` = col_character(),
      Finish = col_character(),
      Name = col_character(),
      batch_file = col_character(),
      status = col_character()
    )
  )
} else {
  inventory <- tibble()
}

processed_files <- read_csv(
  tcg_path("master", "processed_stack_files.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

stack_files <- list.files(
  "Stacks",
  pattern = "\\.csv$",
  full.names = FALSE
)

new_stack_files <- setdiff(stack_files, processed_files$file_name)

new_stacks <- lapply(
  new_stack_files,
  function(file) {
    read_csv(
      file.path("Stacks", file),
      show_col_types = FALSE,
      col_types = cols(
        `Collector number` = col_character(),
        `Scan Order` = col_character(),
        Quantity = col_double(),
        `Scryfall ID` = col_character(),
        `Set code` = col_character(),
        Finish = col_character(),
        Name = col_character()
      )
    ) %>%
      filter(!is.na(`Scryfall ID`)) %>%
      mutate(
        batch_file = file,
        `Collector number` = as.character(`Collector number`),
        `Scan Order` = as.character(`Scan Order`),
        `Scryfall ID` = as.character(`Scryfall ID`),
        `Set code` = as.character(`Set code`),
        Finish = as.character(Finish),
        Name = as.character(Name)
      )
  }
)


if (length(new_stacks) > 0) {
  inventory <- bind_rows(
    inventory,
    bind_rows(new_stacks)
  )

  processed_files <- bind_rows(
    processed_files,
    tibble(file_name = new_stack_files)
  ) %>%
    distinct(file_name)

  write_csv(processed_files, tcg_path("master", "processed_stack_files.csv"))
}

inventory <- inventory %>%
  mutate(
    Quantity = coalesce(as.numeric(Quantity), 1)
  )

if (!"status" %in% names(inventory)) {
  inventory$status <- "active"
}

inventory <- inventory %>%
  mutate(
    status = if_else(is.na(status), "active", status)
  )

sold_file <- tcg_path("master", "sold_cards.csv")

if (file.exists(sold_file)) {

  sold_updates <- read_csv(
    sold_file,
    show_col_types = FALSE,
    col_types = cols(
      batch_file = col_character(),
      `Scan Order` = col_character()
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    `Scan Order` = as.character(`Scan Order`),
    sold_flag = TRUE
  )

  inventory <- inventory %>%
    left_join(
      sold_updates %>%
        select(batch_file, `Scan Order`, sold_flag),
      by = c("batch_file", "Scan Order")
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      status = if_else(!is.na(sold_flag), "sold", status)
    ) %>%
    select(-sold_flag)

  write_csv(inventory, tcg_path("master", "inventory.csv"))
  file.remove(sold_file)
}

inventory <- inventory %>%
  mutate(
    scan_order_num = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(`Scan Order`))
  ) %>%
  arrange(batch_file, scan_order_num, `Scan Order`, desc(status == "sold")) %>%
  distinct(batch_file, `Scan Order`, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(-scan_order_num)

write_csv(inventory, tcg_path("master", "inventory.csv"))
```

## Clean CK data

```{r clean_ck_data}
ck_buylist <- ck_buylist %>%
  mutate(finish = case_when(
  str_detect(name, regex("Foil Etched", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "etched",
  str_detect(set, "\\bFOIL\\b") ~ "foil",
  TRUE ~ "normal"
),
    collector_number = as.character(collector_number),
    clean_set = set,
    clean_set = str_replace(clean_set, " FOIL$", ""),
    clean_set = str_replace(clean_set, " \\([A-Z]+\\)$", ""),
    clean_set = str_replace(clean_set, " JPN Planeswalkers$", ""),
    clean_set = str_replace(clean_set, " Variants$", ""),
    clean_set = str_replace(clean_set, " Commander Decks$", " Commander"),
    clean_set = str_replace(clean_set, "^Mystery Booster/The List$", "The List"),
    clean_set = str_squish(clean_set)
  )
```

```{r attach_set_codes}
ck_buylist <- ck_buylist %>%

    sets_lookup %>%
      transmute(
        clean_set_lookup = name,
        set_code = tolower(code)
      ),
    by = c("clean_set" = "clean_set_lookup")
  )
```

## Handle The List suffix cases

```{r handle_the_list}
ck_buylist <- ck_buylist %>%
  mutate(
    suffix_hint = if_else(
      set_code == "plst",
      str_match(name, "\\(([^()]*)\\)$")[, 2],
      NA_character_
    )
  )

ck_buylist <- ck_buylist %>%
  left_join(
    sets_lookup %>%
      transmute(
        suffix_hint = name,
        suffix_set_code = tolower(code)
      ),
    by = "suffix_hint"
  )

ck_buylist <- ck_buylist %>%
  mutate(
    scryfall_collector_number = if_else(
      set_code == "plst" & !is.na(suffix_set_code),
      paste0(str_to_upper(suffix_set_code), "-", collector_number),
      collector_number
    ),
    scryfall_collector_number = as.character(scryfall_collector_number)
  )
```

## Join sample stack to CK by Scryfall ID

```{r join_stack_to_ck}
stack_with_ck <- inventory %>%
  left_join(
    ck_buylist %>%
      mutate(
        ck_finish_match = case_when(
  str_detect(name, regex("Foil Etched", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "etched",
  str_detect(set, "\\bFOIL\\b") ~ "foil",
  TRUE ~ "normal"
)      ) %>%
      select(
        scryfall_id,
        ck_finish_match,
        cash_price,
        credit_price,
        name,
        set,
        ck_name = name
      ),
    by = c(
      "Scryfall ID" = "scryfall_id",
      "Finish" = "ck_finish_match"
    )
  )

stack_with_ck <- stack_with_ck %>%
  left_join(
    scryfall_cards %>%
      select(
        scryfall_id,
        usd,
        usd_foil,
        usd_etched
      ),
    by = c("Scryfall ID" = "scryfall_id")
  )

stack_with_ck <- stack_with_ck %>%
  mutate(
    tcg_price = case_when(
      Finish == "foil" ~ as.numeric(usd_foil),
      Finish == "etched" ~ as.numeric(usd_etched),
      TRUE ~ as.numeric(usd)
    )
  )
```

```{r export}
library(htmltools)

get_row_color <- function(colors) {
  colors <- str_squish(as.character(colors))

  if (is.na(colors) || colors == "") {
    return("#d9d9d9")   # gray
  }

  color_parts <- unlist(strsplit(colors, ","))
  color_parts <- str_squish(color_parts)
  color_parts <- color_parts[color_parts != ""]

  if (length(color_parts) > 1) {
    return("#ffe59d")   # yellow for multicolor
  }

  if (colors == "W") return("#fffde3")
  if (colors == "U") return("#cfe8ff")
  if (colors == "B") return("#d9d2e9")
  if (colors == "R") return("#f8caca")
  if (colors == "G") return("#cfeccf")

  return("#d9d9d9")     # fallback gray
}

ck_upload <- sell_list %>%
  mutate(
    Title = Name,
    Edition = str_replace(set, " \\([A-Z]+\\)$", ""),
    Foil = if_else(Finish == "foil", "TRUE", "FALSE"),
    Quantity = Quantity
  ) %>%
  select(
    Title,
    Edition,
    Foil,
    Quantity
  )



batch_levels <- sell_list %>%

sell_list$batch_file <- factor(sell_list$batch_file, levels = batch_levels)

# ---- historical CK graph data for cards in sell_list ----

ck_files_hist <- list.files(
  buylist_master_dir,
  pattern = "^cardkingdom_buylist_master_\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

get_snapshot_date <- function(x) {
  as.Date(str_extract(basename(x), "\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}"))
}

cards_to_plot <- sell_list %>%
  distinct(
    `Scryfall ID`,
    Finish,
    Name
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    scryfall_id = `Scryfall ID`,
    finish_match = Finish,
    Name
  )

build_hist_snapshot <- function(file_path) {
  snapshot_date <- get_snapshot_date(file_path)

  read_csv(file_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    select(
      name,
      set,
      collector_number,
      finish,
      cash_price,
      credit_price
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      finish = case_when(
        str_detect(name, regex("Foil Etched", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "etched",
        str_detect(set, "\\bFOIL\\b") ~ "foil",
        TRUE ~ "normal"
      ),
      collector_number = as.character(collector_number),
      clean_set = set,
      clean_set = str_replace(clean_set, " FOIL$", ""),
      clean_set = str_replace(clean_set, " \\([A-Z]+\\)$", ""),
      clean_set = str_replace(clean_set, " JPN Planeswalkers$", ""),
      clean_set = str_replace(clean_set, " Variants$", ""),
      clean_set = str_replace(clean_set, " Commander Decks$", " Commander"),
      clean_set = str_replace(clean_set, "^Mystery Booster/The List$", "The List"),
      clean_set = str_squish(clean_set)
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      sets_lookup %>%
        transmute(
          clean_set_lookup = name,
          set_code = tolower(code)
        ),
      by = c("clean_set" = "clean_set_lookup")
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      suffix_hint = if_else(
        set_code == "plst",
        str_match(name, "\\(([^()]*)\\)$")[, 2],
        NA_character_
      )
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      sets_lookup %>%
        transmute(
          suffix_hint = name,
          suffix_set_code = tolower(code)
        ),
      by = "suffix_hint"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      scryfall_collector_number = if_else(
        set_code == "plst" & !is.na(suffix_set_code),
        paste0(str_to_upper(suffix_set_code), "-", collector_number),
        collector_number
      ),
      scryfall_collector_number = as.character(scryfall_collector_number)
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      scryfall_cards %>%
        select(scryfall_id, set_code, collector_number),
      by = c(
        "set_code" = "set_code",
        "scryfall_collector_number" = "collector_number"
      )
    ) %>%
    transmute(
      snapshot_date = snapshot_date,
      scryfall_id,
      finish_match = finish,
      cash_price = as.numeric(cash_price),
      credit_price = as.numeric(credit_price)
    )
}

ck_hist <- map_dfr(ck_files_hist, build_hist_snapshot)

plot_history <- cards_to_plot %>%

  function exportCheckedRows() {
    const checks = document.querySelectorAll('.sell-check:checked');
    let rows = [];

    checks.forEach(function(box) {
      rows.push([
        box.dataset.title,
        box.dataset.edition,
        box.dataset.foil,
        box.dataset.quantity
      ]);
    });

    if (rows.length === 0) {
      alert('No rows selected.');
      return;
    }

    const csv = rows
      .map(row => row.map(value => `\"${String(value).replace(/\"/g, '\"\"')}\"`).join(','))
      .join('\\n');

    const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    link.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    link.download = 'ck_upload_selected.csv';
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    document.body.removeChild(link);
  }
  
  function setBatchCheckboxes(batchName, isChecked) {
    const boxes = document.querySelectorAll('.sell-check');
    boxes.forEach(function(box) {
      if (box.dataset.batchgroup === batchName) {
        box.checked = isChecked;
      }
    });
  }
  
 function exportSoldRows() {
  const checks = document.querySelectorAll('.sell-check:checked');
  let rows = [];

  checks.forEach(function(box) {
    rows.push([
      box.dataset.batch,
      box.dataset.scanorder,
      box.dataset.title
    ]);
  });

  if (rows.length === 0) {
    alert('No rows selected.');
    return;
  }

  const csv =
    'batch_file,Scan Order,Name\\n' +
    rows.map(row => row.join(',')).join('\\n');

  const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
  const link = document.createElement('a');
  link.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  link.download = 'sold_cards.csv';
  document.body.appendChild(link);
  link.click();
  document.body.removeChild(link);
}
"))
)
```
